source: Tommaso Locatelli2016, Developing and testing a model of wind damage risk for forest plantations in South-West Europe
actual_read_scope: Selected methods/results/limitations sections studied; not a cover-to-cover reading

findings.fact: Sensitivity inputs include joint distributions/correlation; independent marginal draws inadequate for correlated input uncertainties.
Height, DBH, stocking and gap enter interacting components, with species/sample-range dependence; reserve time for reliable measurement.
Rooting/soil low variance contributions (<6% fixing error in selected scope) also reveal limited empirical anchorage formulation; not physical proof roots irrelevant.
Study partly combines maritime pine with Scots pine data; Eucalyptus anchorage site-specific, distributions/correlation matrix may not represent other species.
Windiness is strong driver of annual probability; tail/target climatology and exposed-edge classification need scope-specific validation.
